# Sample Paper

This sample paper studies a small document-to-deck pipeline.

## Problem and Motivation

Document decks need traceable claims so reviewers can audit every slide.

## Method

The pipeline ingests parsed document evidence, creates a grounded plan, builds a PPTX deck, runs deterministic QA, and repairs the plan.

## Main Results

The sample figure demonstrates the document-to-deck flow used by the end-to-end fixture.
